extension.summary: Sand Clock (OpenGL) for 32-bit Android Kodi (many Google TV boxes, Chromecast with Google TV)
extension.description: The same OpenGL Sand Clock as "Sand Clock (OpenGL)", built for 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a). Install this one if your Android or Google TV Kodi is a 32-bit app, which is the case on many Google TV boxes and the Chromecast with Google TV; install "Sand Clock (OpenGL)" on 64-bit Android, macOS and Intel/Apple Macs. A clock whose digits crumble into thousands of falling grains that slide into a heap and sink through the floor, drawn on the GPU, with the same settings as Sand Clock.
extension.disclaimer: Digit shapes from fonts under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see LICENSE.txt. Native add-on built for Kodi 21 Omega, 32-bit ARM Android.
